questions.question: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, what should you do?

options.text: Stay calm and move out of their way.
Flash your lights to show the driver they are wrong.
Do something to get back at the aggressive driver.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stay calm and move out of their way.
questions.explanation: If an aggressive driver cuts you off, stay calm and get out of their way. Trying to get revenge makes the situation more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.
The road will be slippery when wet.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road will be slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road is extra slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Always turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This tells other drivers what you plan to do.

questions.question: What should you do to drive safely at night?

options.text: Increase the distance between you and the car ahead.
Do not drive if you are tired.
Make sure your headlights work properly.

questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as well. Do all of these things to stay safe.

questions.question: If you are in an accident, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your car immediately. Move it out of traffic if you can. Call the police and ask for an ambulance if needed. Help stop severe bleeding with direct pressure. Wait for emergency workers to arrive.

questions.question: You are angry after something happens at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play loud music so you will not think about it.
Drive fast on the highway to release the anger.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving home.
questions.explanation: If you are upset or angry, wait to calm down before you drive. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road will curve to the right and then to the left. Slow down so you can handle these curves safely.

questions.question: What should you do when you approach a railroad crossing?
questions.explanation: When you see signs for a railroad crossing, slow down, look for a train, and be ready to stop. If red lights are flashing or the gate is down, stop 15 to 50 feet before the tracks. Never try to go around the gate.

questions.question: What is the only way to reduce your blood alcohol level?

options.text: Give your body time to remove the alcohol.

questions.correctAnswerText: Give your body time to remove the alcohol.
questions.explanation: Only time will reduce your blood alcohol level. Coffee, exercise, and cold showers cannot lower it. They may keep you awake, but they do not make you sober.

questions.question: What happens when you drink alcohol while taking drugs?

options.text: The effects of both drugs and alcohol get weaker.
The effects of both drugs and alcohol get stronger.

questions.correctAnswerText: The effects of both drugs and alcohol get stronger.
questions.explanation: Mixing alcohol and drugs can make both more powerful. It is unsafe to drive after using either one, and even more dangerous after using both together.

questions.question: You see a driver ahead using one hand and talking to a passenger. What should you do?

options.text: Understand that the driver is not paying full attention to the road.
Do not drive the same way.

questions.explanation: Do not get distracted while driving by talking to passengers, looking for things in your car, reading, sightseeing, or daydreaming. If another driver seems distracted, stay farther away from them. Distracted drivers are more likely to cause accidents.

questions.question: What should you do with your vehicle inspection certificate?

options.text: File it with your income tax return.
Keep it in a safe place at home.
Send it to the County Department of Finance.

questions.explanation: All vehicles driven on public roads must pass an official inspection once a year. When approved, you get a sticker for your vehicle and two copies of the inspection certificate. You must keep the certificate in your vehicle at all times.

questions.question: When driving a vehicle on any public street or highway, you must:

options.text: Show your driver license to police when asked.
Carry your driver license with you.

questions.explanation: You must have a valid driver license with you at all times when driving. You must show it to a police officer if asked.

questions.question: When you take a driving test for a license:

options.text: The vehicle must be in good condition with no safety problems.
You must have a licensed driver take you to the test.

questions.explanation: You must have a licensed driver take you to the test. You must provide a vehicle that is in good condition with a current safety inspection certificate and insurance card. Fix any safety problems before taking the test.

questions.question: If a police officer is directing traffic at an intersection with a working traffic light, drivers should:

options.text: Do what the other cars are doing.

questions.explanation: Traffic lights help traffic move safely and prevent crashes. Drivers, pedestrians, and cyclists must obey these signals. However, when a police officer is directing traffic, follow the officer's directions instead.

questions.question: If you feel tired while driving, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Driving while tired is as dangerous as driving under the influence of alcohol. If you feel tired while driving, stop and rest.

questions.question: Do not pass another vehicle:

options.text: When school bus lights are flashing.

questions.explanation: Never pass if you see an oncoming vehicle, if your view is blocked by a curve or hill, at an intersection, at railroad crossings or bridges, or in any no passing zone. Do not pass a stopped school bus with flashing red lights unless you are on the opposite side of a divided highway.

questions.question: When towing a trailer, make sure it has:

options.text: Wheels that are properly mounted and lubricated, covered with fenders or mud guards.
Tires that are properly filled with air.

questions.explanation: A trailer must have wheels that are properly mounted, lubricated, and covered with fenders or mud guards. The tires must be in good condition and properly filled. The trailer must have the correct lights and reflectors.

questions.question: To drive a heavy truck in Hawaii, you must:

options.text: Have a valid driver license for that type of vehicle.

questions.correctAnswerText: Have a valid driver license for that type of vehicle.
questions.explanation: Drivers of large vehicles must have a valid license for that type of vehicle. See the Hawaii Drivers Manual for information about all license types.

questions.question: When you leave your vehicle unattended, you must:

options.text: Lock the ignition and remove the key.

questions.explanation: When you leave your vehicle, turn off the engine, lock the ignition, remove the key, and set the parking brake.

questions.question: Which equipment can you install on your private vehicle?

options.text: A blue light visible outside the vehicle
A bell, exhaust whistle, or siren

questions.explanation: You cannot add a bell, exhaust whistle, or siren to your vehicle. You cannot add a red light visible from the front or a blue light visible outside. You cannot add a muffler cut-out, muffler by-pass, or any muffler that makes more noise than the original.

questions.question: When is passing prohibited?
questions.explanation: Do not pass another vehicle on hills, curves, intersections, or railroad crossings. These areas are unsafe for passing.

questions.question: When towing a trailer or house trailer, what should you do?

options.text: Have someone ride in the trailer to keep the load steady
Allow only adults to ride in the trailer
Never allow anyone to ride in the trailer
Allow people to ride in house trailers only

questions.correctAnswerText: Never allow anyone to ride in the trailer
questions.explanation: No one should ride in any type of trailer. Riding in trailers is not permitted.

questions.question: What must you do about traffic signs and pavement markings?

options.text: Follow them only when other traffic is present
Follow them only when a police officer is nearby

questions.explanation: Traffic signs, signals, and pavement markings control traffic flow and inform drivers about road conditions. You must always obey them.

questions.question: How can road rage and aggressive driving be reduced?
questions.explanation: To help prevent road rage, use proper turn signals, obey speed limits, and allow plenty of time for your trip.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol impairs judgment and self-control. It slows your reaction time, coordination, and balance. It also impairs your vision and ability to judge distance.

questions.question: When sharing the road with a truck, remember that trucks generally:

options.text: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles
Need less time to pass on a downgrade than smaller vehicles
Need a smaller turning radius than smaller vehicles
Need less time to pass on an incline than smaller vehicles

questions.correctAnswerText: Need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles
questions.explanation: Because of their size, trucks need longer distances to stop than smaller vehicles.

questions.question: A person walking with a white cane or guide dog is likely to be:

options.text: A person involved in a traffic study

questions.explanation: A white cane or guide dog indicates a blind person. Always yield to pedestrians using these tools.

questions.question: When must you stop at a railroad crossing?

options.text: When there is a stop sign
When flashing red signals and gates are operating

questions.explanation: Stop at railroad crossings when directed by a flagger, when there is a stop sign, or when flashing red signals and gates are operating.

questions.question: When approaching a steady green traffic light, what should you do?

options.text: Continue driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection
Stop if a police officer is nearby
Treat the intersection like a four-way stop
Come to a complete stop before proceeding

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue driving unless vehicles or pedestrians are already in the intersection
questions.explanation: At a steady green light, yield to pedestrians in the crosswalk and vehicles still in the intersection. You may proceed, but be ready to stop if the light changes.
